title: factory-findings receipt
description: The orchestrator-minted evidence receipt for one findings-producing verification or audit phase (FACTORY-LOOP-SPEC sections 13/16; Task 10). It is written only by the trusted control plane through the hardened no-follow atomic writer (never by a model role) at the exact moment a verification/audit phase classifies as findings or blocked. The receipt binds the campaign id, the round and phase that produced the findings, the exact commit at which the untrusted phase ran (phase_base_commit), the phase tag recorded in the state digest ledger, the SHA-256 digest of the exact structured phase-result bytes the orchestrator read (result_digest), the deterministic-gate evidence, and the structured findings/blocked references. It is evidence, never orchestration state, and never selects a task.
